original_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE three-view close-up character turnaround sheet for the exact fictional adult character in the input portrait. Input image is the approved facial identity, hairstyle, costume, accessory and rendering-style reference, not a layout template. Preserve the same face, age, skin tone, eye color, hair silhouette and color, jewelry and outfit. Premium Chinese otome semi-realistic 3D CG with luminous finely textured skin, individually groomed hair and detailed materials, matching the input aesthetic.
Layout: EXACT 1536x1024 landscape 3:2 canvas, pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Exactly THREE separate evenly spaced bust portraits in ONE horizontal row, equal 512-pixel-wide invisible columns. Left: exact frontal 0-degree view looking at camera. Center: exact 90-degree profile facing screen RIGHT, only the near eye visible, nose and chin clearly in profile, far eye hidden. Right: exact 180-degree rear view, centered back of head, nape and back of shoulders; absolutely no face or eye visible. Rotate the entire head, neck and shoulders together. All three have upright heads, camera exactly at eye level with near-orthographic long-lens perspective, identical physical head scale and consistent crown/eye/chin height. Head and upper-shoulder close-ups, crop just below collarbones, no hands or waist. Complete hair, ears, hats and highest ornaments inside each panel, comfortable white margins above and between silhouettes, no overlap. For tall ornaments reduce all THREE views equally to keep entire ornaments visible. Neutral closed mouth. Bright neutral soft studio illumination, subtle dimensional modeling shadows, no colored lighting or gray backdrop. Hair and rear costume inferred coherently from the same design, no invented extra ornaments, no loss or duplication of jewelry. No labels, text, numbers, divider lines, logos, watermarks, extra subjects, inset panels or additional views. Especially avoid three-quarter views: the center MUST be true 90-degree profile and right MUST be true 180-degree back.
Identity details: Male age 26, athletic. Short black textured hair with a lifted choppy fringe. Olive-green narrow eyes, broad squarer jaw, compact midface, thick slightly asymmetric eyebrows, straight substantial nose, defined medium lips with a subtle smile. Healthy light bronze skin. Black-and-ivory motorsport racing suit with original curved panels and a tiny ochre accent, no sponsor text or brand patches. Alert friendly athletic character.
